settings.title: Description
settings.content:
Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is prepared with milk sourced from Indian breed cows raised in the fertile lands of Braj Bhumi, the Land of Lord Krishna. Known for its rich heritage, this region nurtures cows on natural pastures without the use of chemical pesticides or synthetic hormones. Certified to international organic standards, our ghee offers a pure, unadulterated experience, ensuring every spoonful supports a healthier lifestyle.


Our ghee is packed with essential nutrients, including fatty acids, vitamins, and antioxidants. These components make it ideal for promoting better digestion, enhancing skin and hair health, and supporting immunity. The traditional process of slow cooking retains its authentic flavor, golden texture, and rich aroma, perfect for cooking or incorporating into daily wellness routines.
Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is free from antibiotics and synthetic additives, ensuring a pure and natural product. Crafted with care, it brings the goodness of Indian breed cow milk to your plate, making it a nutrient-rich and versatile addition to your home.

settings.title: Key Features
settings.content:
1. Traditional Bilona Method: Ghee made through the traditional process of churning curd to preserve natural nutrients.
2. Sourced from Indian Breed Cows: Made with milk from Indian breed cows, raised on chemical-free fodder.
3. Rich in Nutrients: Contains healthy fats and essential nutrients that support overall well-being.
4. Supports Digestion: Known for aiding digestion and gut health.
5. Free from Chemicals: No pesticides, synthetic hormones, or antibiotics used.
6. Versatile Use: Ideal for cooking and can also be used for daily wellness practices.
7. Natural Flavor: Retains a pure, natural flavor and aroma.

settings.heading: What is Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee?
settings.row_content: Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is a high-quality clarified butter made from the milk of Indian breed cows. These cows are raised on organic farms and fed natural fodder. Prepared using traditional methods, this ghee preserves its rich flavor and purity.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee?
settings.row_content:
Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is known for its:

  • Rich, natural flavor that enhances the taste of dishes.
  • Use in traditional recipes for cooking and frying.
  • Essential nutrients like vitamins A, D, E, and K.
  • Smooth texture, making it easy to blend into various dishes

settings.heading: How is Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee different from regular ghee?
settings.row_content: Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is made from the milk of Indian breed cows raised organically without synthetic hormones or antibiotics. Unlike regular ghee, it is crafted using traditional methods, ensuring a natural, high-quality product.

settings.heading: How can Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee be used in cooking?
settings.row_content:
Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is versatile and can be used in:

  • Frying, sautéing, and cooking daily meals
  • Topping on chapatis, rice, and parathas
  • Preparing traditional sweets and festive dishes
  • Adding flavor and richness to soups, dals, and gravies

settings.heading: What makes Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee organic?
settings.row_content: Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee is certified organic. It is made from the milk of Indian breed cows fed organic fodder and raised without synthetic hormones or antibiotics. No artificial preservatives or chemicals are used in the preparation process.

settings.heading: How should Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee be stored?
settings.row_content: Store Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use an airtight container to maintain its freshness and aroma.

settings.heading: What is the shelf life of Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee?
settings.row_content: Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee has a shelf life of up to 12 months when stored properly. It does not require refrigeration, making it convenient for long-term use.

settings.heading: Is Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee suitable for all age groups?
settings.row_content: Yes, Barsana Magic Organic Cow Ghee can be suitable for all age groups. It can be a valuable addition to the diet of children, adults, and the elderly.
